lines: Zillow found solar homes sold for
scenes.say: A twenty nineteen Zillow analysis found homes with solar sold for about four point one percent more.
Berkeley Lab research found buyers paid roughly four dollars per watt of owned solar.
But that's for owned systems. Leased systems can complicate a sale.
Tip: keep production records, warranties, and permits ready for appraisers and buyers.
Thinking about resale value? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
